Name: ModCollectionAlbum
Author: Clmny
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]ModCollectionAlbum keeps the vanilla collection page clean by moving items added by other content mods into a dedicated Mod Album. It automatically recognizes items from mods like SVE, Ridgeside Village, and East Scarp, then groups them by their source mod so you can browse every modded item separately. [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI and Stardew Valley 1.6 first. Download ModCollectionAlbum and extract the folder into your game's Mods directory, so the final path looks like
[/color]
[code]Mods/ModCollectionAlbum[/code][color=#D4D4D8]. Launch the game through SMAPI and open the collection page from the in-game menu. A "mod图鉴" entry will appear at the bottom of the left tab list. [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
The vanilla shipping, fish, artifacts, minerals, and cooking tabs keep only vanilla items, and their original positions and sizes are never changed. Clicking "mod图鉴" hides the original collection page and opens the Mod Album interface, where each source mod gets its own tab arranged around the interface edges. Items are displayed at their original size, with collected items bright and uncollected items dimmed. The mod also supports renaming tabs and merging one mod's tab into another, which can be configured manually or through GMCM.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0 or newer is required. Stardew Valley 1.6 is required. Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) is optional and only needed if you want to edit settings inside the game. [/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to the Stardew Valley modding community for keeping the game alive, and to the authors of SVE, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, and other content mods for inspiring this project. Thanks also to the GMCM team for making in-game configuration possible. [/color]
